property_summary: The return value of transfer must always be true when the transaction does not revert, but the mutant incorrectly returns false.
For any admissible input (including cases where an external call 'fails' but does not revert), the return value of transfer must always be true, but the mutant incorrectly returns false.
For any admissible input where transfer does not revert, the return value must be true; the mutant incorrectly returns false for all non-reverting inputs.
For any admissible input, the return value of transfer is always true regardless of external call failures; the mutant incorrectly returns false when at least one external call reverts.
